title: Beerock
description: This project changes bedrock to beerock!
body:
Hi again!

This time i create new resource pack - beerock!!!

Because of it, i wanted to participate in planet minecraft jam "bees make honey, not jam" by yurpio, i had to create something. And i create this.
I CHANGED BEDROCK TO BEEROCK. Just 1 letter. BUT. It makes a lot for bedrock. Really.

Enjoy!
